setting: environment exact, training seeds 301,302,303,304,305 (5 runs per arm)
origin_text: wall clock from the start of the run: memetic algorithm from the start of the process that solves the instance (instance loading, start schedules and numba warm-up included); CP-SAT model arms from the start of the arm, model building included (instance load and hint validation before it not timed by the runner); the neighbourhood-search arm from its start

verdicts.comparison: (i) policy against each rule-started arm, per size
verdicts.sel: ahead: the instance-level 95% interval lies below zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is shorter" (draws of that interval) is below alpha; behind: the interval lies above zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is longer" (its own Holm family) is below alpha; not distinguishable otherwise. No seed-level test exists for one run.
verdicts.all: ahead: the hierarchical 95% interval lies below zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values for "the policy is shorter" (seed-level t over the per-run means, hierarchical bootstrap) are below alpha; behind: the interval lies above zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values for "the policy is longer" (each kind with its own Holm family) are below alpha; not distinguishable otherwise (p89_public_family.superiority_verdict).
verdicts.other: shorter budgets, the pooled rows and comparisons (ii) to (iv) carry interval and direction only

sign: first-named method minus second, in percent of the second (negative = first-named shorter)

selection.rule: lowest validation score of the kept checkpoint (arm_registry.select_seed)

selected.rule: ahead: the instance-level 95% interval lies below zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is shorter" (draws of that interval) is below alpha; behind: the interval lies above zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is longer" (its own Holm family) is below alpha; not distinguishable otherwise. No seed-level test exists for one run.

all_seeds.rule: ahead: the hierarchical 95% interval lies below zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values for "the policy is shorter" (seed-level t over the per-run means, hierarchical bootstrap) are below alpha; behind: the interval lies above zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values for "the policy is longer" (each kind with its own Holm family) are below alpha; not distinguishable otherwise (p89_public_family.superiority_verdict).
all_seeds.scheme: crossed hierarchical bootstrap over training runs and base instances, fresh default_rng(11)

groups.rule: beside Pool, the pooled row of each group over its combinations that the campaign holds: the estimator, the clustering by base instance and the generator rule of Pool (a fresh generator per entry), interval and direction only; an entry lists the combinations that entered and, as Pool, needs two or more of them with numbers (a group with fewer in the campaign is absent, here too); on the request clock a group has a number when both methods have a schedule on every cell of its combinations; results.<size>.ix.<group> holds (ix) over the group's cells
groups.csv: column group: all on the rows per combination and of Pool; the value csv_group on the pooled rows of a group (combination = the group's key), after the rows of every size

design_rule: results.<size>.design: the instances of each arm in the plan and, on the request clock, of the policy records (policy_sample); range_given: every token of the arm gives an instance range, which is then the design of the arm; an arm with a token without one plans the size's evidence instances and must cover them

solver_model.rule: valid records of CP-SAT started from the rule schedule, per size, combination and pooled entry (two or more combinations): median, minimum and maximum over the cells of the variables of the initial model (solver_log_head: the first line starting "#Variables:" after the line starting "Initial optimization model", before the next model of the log), build_s, peak_rss_gb and the time of the first row of anytime (the record's clock: from the solver call for a model configuration, from the start of the arm for the neighbourhood search); a record without a value leaves it out and is listed under missing; descriptive statistics, no random number

fields.peak_rss_gb: peak memory of the solve in GB
fields.first_incumbent_s: seconds until the first incumbent, on the record's clock (for a model configuration from the solver call, after the model build)
